requirement.statement: AI Workflow authoring SHALL use a bounded target-first model control loop over structured atomic workspace commands and exact-revision proof/publication receipts, while deterministic code MUST NOT infer workflow semantics from natural-language matching.

case.given: A workflow actor has selected a coherent set of file additions, updates and deletions
case.when: It submits one structured patch with the expected working revision
case.then: The component SHALL validate all operations and commit the candidate bundle atomically
A stale revision or invalid operation SHALL leave the prior bundle unchanged

case.given: A natural-language workflow request enters authoring
case.when: Targets, stage, topology, authorization or business behavior are selected
case.then: The dedicated workflow actor and system Skill SHALL make the semantic choice
Host code MUST NOT use regex, keyword, substring or heuristic matching to choose it

case.given: An authoring session has a published revision and an append-only publication receipt
case.when: The actor mutates the working bundle
case.then: The working revision SHALL advance, current proofs SHALL become stale and dirty SHALL be true
The prior publication receipt SHALL remain historical authority and the new work MUST NOT be reported as published

case.given: The same authoring session publishes more than one revision
case.when: A later publication succeeds or recovery follows an interrupted rebase
case.then: The system SHALL append a new immutable receipt and update only the latest receipt projection
Earlier publication receipts MUST NOT be overwritten or deleted

case.given: A candidate revision is published and passes canonical readback
case.when: The same authoring session computes its next diff
case.then: The published bundle SHALL be the new base revision
Unchanged published files MUST NOT be reported as newly created

case.given: A working revision is prepared for publication
case.then: Diff, canonical validation, non-effectful static projection, build and acceptance disposition receipts SHALL identify the same revision and bundle digest

case.given: An exact candidate revision is prepared for publication
case.then: The component SHALL derive required or not_required only from a canonical profile/manifest or explicit structured definition policy
Required SHALL need a passing isolated candidate receipt; not_required SHALL need a recorded policy source; natural-language and name matching are forbidden

case.given: Candidate acceptance exercises an effectful workflow before publication
case.when: The canonical runtime dispatches test effects
case.then: It SHALL use injected isolated Eidolon effect doubles or fixtures and MUST NOT access real networks, external services or business systems
Real effects SHALL require a separately authorized post-publication execution and SHALL produce an execution receipt outside publication proof

case.given: A static dry-run does not dispatch workflow effects
case.when: Proof is reported or publication is requested
case.then: The system SHALL retain it as a required exact-revision publication proof, label it as non-effectful static projection and MUST NOT claim external-source or failure-path acceptance
An acceptance disposition receipt SHALL always be present; required SHALL reference isolated candidate evidence and not_required SHALL reference its canonical or explicit structured policy source

case.given: Explicit publication authorization and a current complete receipt set exist
case.when: The component publishes and canonically reads back the artifact
case.then: It SHALL emit an immutable publication receipt containing revision, artifact digest, target, definition identity and diff/validation/static-projection/build/acceptance proof identities

case.given: One or more recoverable authoring sessions exist
case.then: It SHALL return briefs in stable order with an opaque cursor, total and truncated semantics
The default page size SHALL be 20, the hard maximum SHALL be 100, and full validation bindings, source bodies or dry-run projections SHALL be excluded

case.given: An actor needs current proof and diagnostics identity
case.then: It SHALL return counts plus at most 20 diagnostic codes or receipt references with truncated metadata, while full authoritative metadata remains available only through an explicit detail read

case.given: A brief or summary has been returned
case.then: The projector SHALL derive a new view from the authoritative session and MUST NOT persist or write back an independent summary state

case.given: The dedicated workflow actor reaches a ready, published, waiting or failed authoring outcome
case.when: WorkflowAuthor returns to its parent actor
case.then: The model SHALL only request the terminal transition and the component/session authority SHALL generate a typed receipt from persisted authoring-session, revision, dirty, proof and publication identities
The parent SHALL NOT parse free-form prose or repeat successful proof operations

case.given: A model claims a receipt or presents one whose session, revision or proof identity is stale or forged
case.when: The high-level authoring tool resolves completion
case.then: The component SHALL reject the claim and MUST NOT promote it to authoritative completion

case.given: The standard two-file authoring fixture has no diagnostics
case.when: It runs through a deterministic scripted provider
case.then: The journey SHALL require no more than six authoring model completions and SHALL commit its first workspace mutation by the fourth completion
